items.method: Cross-read the single-name options tape (call-versus-put premium, call fraction and the strike and days-to-expiry of the heaviest same-session prints) against the dealer-positioning corridor (positive dealer gamma, flip, put and call walls, front expected move, pin-to-maxpain playbook), the intraday auction state and cash-market breadth, then judge whether outright put-heavy premium meeting a positive-gamma pin that spot has decayed down onto — with the auction trending lower but breadth repaired to the participation line — is a downside break beginning or a hedge flow still being absorbed by a long-gamma pin, and anchor a direction-correct invalidation ABOVE spot at the reclaim that would falsify the downside-pressure caution.
items.note: The genuinely new configuration this window is that the same defensive derivative tape now sits over a repaired cash internal rather than a collapsed one, so the downside pressure and the participation signal disagree. Aggregate single-name premium is still outright put-heavy — a 0.3836 call fraction, $1.825B of call premium against $2.933B of put premium across 12 tickers, with 1966 contracts clearing the $250k bar inside 30 days (650 of 19178 considered). The heaviest same-session prints are defensive and near-dated: an IWM 290 put at $17.0M on 34.8x its open interest fourteen days out and an NVDA 225 put at $147.3M on 6.76x open interest zero days out outweigh the one large upside print, a GOOGL 345 call at $6.24M on 5.86x open interest zero days out. This lands on a positive dealer-gamma structure that spot has decayed down onto rather than a mid-corridor pin: SPY is 769.16, just above the 768.96 flip and beneath the 770 call wall, inside a plus-or-minus 3.08 front expected move, with signed net GEX around +0.13B and the gamma playbook reading pin-to-maxpain with a patient, same-session-fade hold. The intraday auction is a Trend day · down under Mixed control (VWAP 770.95, +0.09% gap, 79 bars), so the flip is being tested from above. What breaks the prior collapsed-breadth read is that cash participation has recovered close to the line — market-heatmap breadth is 59.86% of 134 constituents positive, only a 0.14-point miss of the 60% broad-participation threshold — so the down-trend tape no longer rests on a shrinking cohort. Put-heavy near-dated premium pressing a flip-level long-gamma pin under a down-trend auction is still a rally-quality caution weighted to the downside, but with breadth no longer confirming it the standoff is unresolved rather than a break in progress. Watch a decisive loss of the 768.96 flip and the 768 put wall as the confirming trigger that the pin fails downward and dealers flip toward selling weakness; the downside-pressure caution is invalidated on a daily close above ~771.00 on SPY, which clears the 770 call wall, reasserts the long-gamma grind and shows the put premium was absorbed rather than leading.
items.title: Single-name option premium stays outright put-heavy (0.3836 call fraction, $1.825B calls vs $2.933B puts across 12 names, 1966 contracts clearing the $250k bar inside 30 days) pressing a positive-gamma pin that spot sits right on — SPY is 769.16 just above the 768.96 flip and beneath the 770 call wall inside a plus-or-minus 3.08 expected move, the auction reads Trend day · down at VWAP 770.95, and the heaviest prints are an IWM 290 put at $17.0M on 34.8x open interest and an NVDA 225 put at $147.3M zero days out, even as cash breadth has healed back to 59.86% of 134 constituents

items.method: Cross-read the mixed US internals (breadth repaired to the participation line, put-heavy single-name premium, a down-trend intraday auction) against where leadership is actually being scored — the global-rotation composite (Singapore, Taiwan, Canada ahead of the US-heavy ACWI) and the real-assets 0-100 composite (crypto and broad commodities leading, monetary metals lagging, oil middling) — to test whether risk appetite is sitting offshore and in real assets while the domestic tape wavers, then, finding the leadership cluster resolves to relative-strength scores and composite rankings rather than any single committed-universe price level, withhold a tactical call rather than publish one that cannot be scored.
items.note: The second cross-model pattern this window is that the leadership scores continue to point away from the domestic tape even as US internals steady, so the migration is a where-is-the-bid observation rather than a confirmation of index direction. The US picture is mixed rather than uniformly weak: market-heatmap breadth has recovered to 59.86% of 134 constituents (a 0.14-point miss of the 60% line), single-name option premium is put-heavy at a 0.3836 call fraction ($2.933B puts versus $1.825B calls), and the intraday auction is a Trend day · down under Mixed control at VWAP 770.95. Against that, global rotation ranks EWS (Singapore) first at 87.9/100 versus the US-heavy ACWI, with EWT (Taiwan) 77.8, EWC (Canada) 73.5 and EWG (Germany) 67.5 ahead of a middling US read, and the Singapore leg is a local-equity-led move with an FX drag rather than a dollar tailwind. Real assets are led by crypto and broad commodities — ETH-USD 76.8, agriculture DBA 70.8, bitcoin (BTC-USD) 69, PDBC 68.4 (six-month momentum +23.26%) and DBC 68.3 (+24.64%), with IBIT 63.2 — while the defensive monetary metals lag badly: gold (GLD) 36 with six-month momentum -15.47% and silver (SLV) 16.9 with -29.38%, and oil (USO) 57.5 sits in the middle on a flat +0.47% three-month pulse. Offshore-equity and speculative real-asset leadership with lagging gold and silver, set against a defensive US sector rotation that leans on discretionary (XLY Improving, accel +1.35) with healthcare the named leader (XLV, accel +0.93) as energy weakens (XLE, accel -0.11), is a where-is-the-bid observation, not a scoreable trade: the cluster resolves to relative-strength states and 0-100 composite scores, none of which is a single committed-universe instrument with a direction-correct price trigger this window, so a tactical call is withheld rather than published with only a working side. Watch whether US breadth reclaims the 60% participation line to close the gap with the offshore and real-asset leadership, or whether the down-trend domestic tape drags the composite reads lower; until an instrument-level price trigger is in view, the cluster is carried as counter-weight context to the index-level downside-pressure caution, not as its own call.
items.title: Leadership sits offshore and in real assets while US internals send a mixed signal — global rotation ranks Singapore (EWS 87.9), Taiwan (EWT 77.8) and Canada (EWC 73.5) ahead of the US-heavy ACWI, and real assets are led by crypto and broad commodities (ETH-USD 76.8, DBA 70.8, BTC-USD 69, PDBC 68.4, DBC 68.3) with gold (GLD 36, six-month momentum -15.47%) and silver (SLV 16.9, -29.38%) lagging and oil (USO 57.5) middling, a cross-model migration that resolves to no single committed-universe price level
